packageRules.description: Base image digest bumps: weekly, only after the new digest is 3 days old, and auto-merged ONLY through GitHub's native auto-merge, which waits for the required status checks on main (build + boot test). See docs/adr/0001-base-image.md.
A new Fedora release (e.g. 45 -> 46) is a real upgrade: never auto-merged; a human tests it first.
GitHub Actions stay pinned to commit SHAs; grouped weekly, never auto-merged (they run with access to CI).
